name: io.github.Bitwiz12/speedy-sticks-mcp
title: Speedy Sticks MCP
description: MCP for lab testing and mobile phlebotomy: AI agents book at-home blood draws in all 50 states.

tools.name: speedy_public_booking_app
tools.description: Opens Speedy Sticks' interactive booking form in the chat so the person can book an at-home blood draw or specimen collection in one place: coverage check, service and price, signing in to their Speedy Sticks account with a one-time code (the account is made if they are new), their details, agreeing to the privacy policy and the terms and conditions, the secure card page or a saved card, the confirmation with the booking reference, and a secure link to upload their doctor's order. Call it as soon as someone wants to book; pass the ZIP, the service and everything they already told you as prefill (name, contact, address, date, window, people, fasting, order or kit, whether the visit is one time or recurring and how often, and their notes) so the form opens filled in at the first step that still needs them. They always enter the code, review, tick consent and handle payment themselves. While the form is open, do not re-ask for details it collects. If the host cannot display forms, use the speedy_public_* step tools instead.

postal_code.description: ZIP code of the visit, if known; coverage is checked up front.

prefill.description: Everything the person already told you, so the form opens pre-filled at the first step that still needs them (they still review, consent and pay).

date_of_birth.description: Calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD, interpreted in the collection address's local time zone.

address_line_2.description: Apartment, suite or floor, if any. A buzzer or gate code goes in notes.

requested_date.description: Calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD, interpreted in the collection address's local time zone.

requested_time.description: Start of the hourly window, e.g. 09:00.

sub_service_ids.description: "1" = doctor's order, "2" = kit at home (Mobile Phlebotomy).

kit_return_courier.description: When they have a kit: the courier on its return label ("fedex", "ups", "usps" for the post office, "unsure"), or "patient" when they want the kit left with them to send back.

lab.description: When they have a doctor's order: the laboratory it goes to ("labcorp", "quest", "other" with lab_name, "unsure").

notes.description: Directions, access, or anything the phlebotomist should know about the patient; lands in the appointment notes.

repeat_frequency.description: Set when the person needs this visit regularly: weekly, biweekly (every other week) or monthly. Omit for a one-time visit.

repeat_until.description: Last possible visit date of a recurring visit, if they gave one.

order_expires.description: Expiration date printed on the provider's standing order, if they have one.

tools.name: speedy_public_sign_in
tools.description: Before anything personal is asked or shown, the person signs in to their Speedy Sticks account, exactly as on Speedy Sticks' website: this sends a one-time code to their email (or by text to their phone). New to Speedy Sticks? Their account is made when they enter the code. Then ask for the code and call speedy_public_enter_code. Prices, coverage and the services can be checked without signing in.

send_by.description: "sms" texts the code to the phone on their account, or to `phone` when they are new.

phone.description: Their mobile number, to text the code to when they have no account yet.

tools.name: speedy_public_enter_code
tools.description: Checks the one-time code from speedy_public_sign_in. The person is then signed in to their own Speedy Sticks account (made now if they are new, with the details given) and a session is returned: pass it to every booking tool. Booking, the card, checking and cancelling happen as them, and they see the same bookings when they sign in on Speedy Sticks' website. The session ends after an hour unused; sign in again with a new code.

email.description: The same email the code was sent for.

date_of_birth.description: Calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD, interpreted in the collection address's local time zone.

sex.description: Sex on record, required by Speedy Sticks' patient record.

phone.description: Mobile number the phlebotomist can call on the day.

tools.name: speedy_public_sign_out
tools.description: Ends the person's session here. Call it when they are done, or ask to sign out.

tools.name: speedy_public_check_coverage
tools.description: Checks whether Speedy Sticks can come to a US ZIP code. Call this first; do not collect personal details for an area that is not covered. No sign-in needed.

tools.name: speedy_public_list_services
tools.description: Lists the services Speedy Sticks offers (today: Mobile Phlebotomy at-home blood draw, Therapeutic Phlebotomy, Rabies Titer at-home collection) with the standard price per appointment and the price per additional person. Sub-services describe what the person has for the visit (Kit = a kit at home, Order = a doctor's order). No sign-in needed.

search.description: Optional case-insensitive filter on the service name.

tools.name: speedy_public_estimate_price
tools.description: Returns the price for one at-home appointment on a given date. The price depends on how soon the visit is (next-day costs the most; it drops each day further out, down to the standard price) plus a fixed amount per additional person. With the full address it returns Speedy Sticks' own ESTIMATE for that address and date; with only a ZIP code it returns the date-based rate (pricing_status BALLPARK), which is enough to answer 'how much would Thursday cost?' before collecting an address. price_by_date says when the standard price starts, so offer that date to someone who is flexible. Charged per appointment, not per draw or test; the final price is confirmed at review. No sign-in needed.

number_of_people.description: People being collected at the same visit.

location.description: Full address, for the exact estimate.

address_line_2.description: Apartment, suite or floor, if any. Up to 60 characters: it is kept with the visit, shown beside the address, and put first in the notes the phlebotomist reads. Gate codes and other access notes go in the visit notes.

postal_code.description: ZIP code only, when the address is not known yet (date-based rate).

requested_date.description: Local collection date; must be in the future.

requested_time.description: Start of the arrival window, if chosen; with timezone it prices the exact appointment time, as the booking will.

timezone.description: IANA time zone of the collection location, e.g. America/Chicago.

repeat_frequency.description: For a recurring visit: also returns standing_order with the price of the first visit and of each later visit (later visits get the standing-order rate).

tools.name: speedy_public_price_calendar
tools.description: Shows what one at-home appointment costs on each of the coming days, so the person can pick the day that suits both their schedule and their budget. The price is highest for a next-day visit and falls for each day further out, down to the standard price. Returns one row per day with its price and what it saves against the dearest day shown, the first date with the lowest price, and a one-line headline. Use it whenever someone asks what a visit costs, is flexible on the date, or hesitates at a price: show the days as a short list and point out the lowest-price date. Needs only the ZIP code. No sign-in needed.

start_date.description: First day to show; defaults to tomorrow.

requested_time.description: Start of the arrival window, if already chosen.

timezone.description: IANA time zone of the collection location, e.g. America/Chicago.

tools.name: speedy_public_start_booking
tools.description: Requires sign-in (speedy_public_sign_in, then speedy_public_enter_code). Step 1 of 2 for a booking. Call only after they have agreed to the service, date, arrival window start (the phlebotomist arrives within 1–2 hours of it), address and the price estimate. Checks coverage, prices the visit, and returns their saved cards and a secure link where THEY can save a new card. Nothing is booked yet. Then call speedy_public_confirm_booking. Never ask for card details in chat.

session.description: The session from speedy_public_enter_code (the person signed in). Leave it out when this connection was signed in to Speedy Sticks. To sign in: ask the person for their email, call speedy_public_sign_in to send them a one-time code, ask them for the code, then call speedy_public_enter_code. Pass the session it returns as `session`.

date_of_birth.description: Calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD, interpreted in the collection address's local time zone.

gender.description: Required by Speedy Sticks' patient record.

email.description: Not needed: the booking uses the email the person signed in with.

phone.description: Mobile number the phlebotomist can call on the day.

service_name.description: e.g. "Mobile Phlebotomy"; used when service_id is unknown.

sub_service_ids.description: From speedy_public_list_services: "Order" (doctor's order) or "Kit" (kit at home) for Mobile Phlebotomy.

requested_date.description: Calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD, interpreted in the collection address's local time zone.

requested_time.description: Start of the arrival window, 06:00 to 17:00 local; the phlebotomist arrives within 1–2 hours of it.

timezone.description: IANA time zone of the collection location, e.g. America/Chicago.

fasting_required.description: Set true only when the person said this is a fasting draw (fasting draws must start by 11:00 local). Leave it false when they did not say: the appointment then records nothing about fasting.

repeat.description: Set when the person needs this visit on a routine (ask: one time, or recurring?). This booking is the first visit; the standing order is requested with it, on the same weekday, window, address and card. Omit for a one-time visit.

frequency.description: How often the visit repeats: weekly, biweekly (every other week) or monthly.

end_date.description: Last possible visit date; omit for open-ended.

order_expires.description: Expiration date printed on the provider's standing order, if they have one.

address_line_2.description: Apartment, suite or floor, if any. Gate codes, buzzers and parking go in details.notes.

place_id.description: place_id of the suggestion the person confirmed in speedy_public_address_lookup (marks the address as verified).

has_doctors_order.description: True when the person has a doctor's order; they upload it on Speedy Sticks' secure page after booking (document_upload link) or on the website.

kit_return_courier.description: When the person has a kit at home ("Kit"): which courier the kit goes back to the lab with, as printed on its return label. "fedex", "ups", "usps" (the post office) or "unsure" when they do not know yet.

lab.description: When they have a doctor's order: which laboratory it goes to, as printed on the order ("labcorp", "quest", "other" with lab_name, or "unsure"). Speedy Sticks takes the sample to the nearest site of that lab that is open after the visit.

lab_name.description: With lab "other": the laboratory's name, as on the order.

notes.description: Anything the person wants the phlebotomist to know that the form cannot anticipate: directions and access, and relevant information about the patient (mobility, anxiety, difficult veins). Goes straight into the appointment notes Speedy Sticks staff see. Do not collect the doctor's order or test details here.

consent_to_privacy_policy.description: True only after the person has been shown Speedy Sticks' privacy policy link and agreed to it and to being contacted about the appointment.

consent_to_terms.description: True only after the person has been shown Speedy Sticks' terms and conditions link (speedy_public_booking_app's terms_url, or speedy://public/policies) and agreed to them. Speedy Sticks keeps the agreement with the booking; no booking without it.

idempotency_key.description: Client-generated unique key (e.g. a UUID). Resending the same key with the same arguments returns the original result instead of repeating the action.

tools.name: speedy_public_confirm_booking
tools.description: Requires sign-in. Step 2 of 2. Books the appointment as the signed-in person, with the card they saved on the payment link, one of their saved cards, or a payment from their AI wallet (payment_data, when the draft's payment.agent_wallet.supported is true). The booking comes in pending and nothing is charged now: Speedy Sticks reviews it and bills the visit later. Returns the booking reference. Safe to call again: if the card is not saved yet it says so, and if the draft is already booked it returns the same booking.

session.description: The session from speedy_public_enter_code (the person signed in). Leave it out when this connection was signed in to Speedy Sticks. To sign in: ask the person for their email, call speedy_public_sign_in to send them a one-time code, ask them for the code, then call speedy_public_enter_code. Pass the session it returns as `session`.

saved_payment_method_id.description: One of payment.saved_cards from the draft. Books with that card instead of the card page.

payment_data.description: Pay from the person's AI wallet instead of a card, when payment.agent_wallet.supported is true. The token must allow at least agent_wallet.amount_cents and stay valid until agent_wallet.valid_until (the visit's start). Nothing is charged at booking: Speedy Sticks keeps the token and charges it once, when it bills the visit. Not for repeat visits.

token.description: A Stripe shared payment token (spt_…) your platform issued from the person's wallet for this purchase.

tools.name: speedy_public_get_booking
tools.description: Requires sign-in. Returns the status, arrival window and pricing of one of the person's own bookings, and `history` when available. Someone else's booking, or one that does not exist, reports NOT_FOUND. The person can also see all their bookings on Speedy Sticks' website.

session.description: The session from speedy_public_enter_code (the person signed in). Leave it out when this connection was signed in to Speedy Sticks. To sign in: ask the person for their email, call speedy_public_sign_in to send them a one-time code, ask them for the code, then call speedy_public_enter_code. Pass the session it returns as `session`.

booking_reference.description: Booking reference given at confirmation, e.g. "18492".

tools.name: speedy_public_cancel_booking
tools.description: Requires sign-in. Cancels one of the person's own bookings. Cancelling usually costs a fee ($50 at least 24 hours before the visit, the full visit price inside 24 hours; in the last 8 hours only by calling Speedy Sticks), so this is two-phase: call with confirm=false (default) to get the consequences and the accepted reasons, and read consequences.summary to the person: the fee, how it is collected (charged to their card or their assistant's wallet when they cancel, or kept from what they already paid) and any refund. Only after the person explicitly agrees, call again with confirm=true, the confirmation_token, a reason and an idempotency_key. Canceled bookings cannot be reinstated.

session.description: The session from speedy_public_enter_code (the person signed in). Leave it out when this connection was signed in to Speedy Sticks. To sign in: ask the person for their email, call speedy_public_sign_in to send them a one-time code, ask them for the code, then call speedy_public_enter_code. Pass the session it returns as `session`.

booking_reference.description: Booking reference given at confirmation, e.g. "18492".

reason.description: Reason in the person's words; matched to Speedy Sticks' reason list (or pass reason_id).

reason_id.description: Id from available_reasons in the preview.

confirmation_token.description: confirmation_token from the preview (confirm=false). Required when confirm=true: it ties the confirmation to the fee the person was shown.

tools.name: speedy_public_address_lookup
tools.description: Returns verified address suggestions for a partly typed US street address (house number + street, optionally city or ZIP). Each suggestion carries a place_id and the exact street, city, state and ZIP. Use it to confirm the collection address with the person before booking, then pass the chosen place_id and components in speedy_public_start_booking.location so the booking has a verified address. No sign-in needed.

query.description: What the person typed so far, e.g. "210 catherine st".

near_postal_code.description: ZIP from the coverage check; matching suggestions are listed first.

tools.name: speedy_public_draft_status
tools.description: Requires sign-in. Returns the state of one of the person's booking drafts: AWAITING_PAYMENT_METHOD (send the payment link or offer a saved card), READY_TO_CONFIRM (card saved; call speedy_public_confirm_booking), BOOKED or EXPIRED. Use it after the person says they saved a card, or to resend the payment link.

session.description: The session from speedy_public_enter_code (the person signed in). Leave it out when this connection was signed in to Speedy Sticks. To sign in: ask the person for their email, call speedy_public_sign_in to send them a one-time code, ask them for the code, then call speedy_public_enter_code. Pass the session it returns as `session`.

tools.name: speedy_public_make_standing_order
tools.description: Requires sign-in. Sets a booking to repeat as a standing order: the same service, address, weekday, arrival window and card on file, weekly, every other week or monthly, until an end date (or until the doctor's standing order expires). The booking is the first visit and keeps its price; each later visit costs the standing-order rate returned here. Speedy Sticks checks the request against the doctor's order before scheduling more visits (status REQUESTED until then) and notifies the person when it is approved. Confirm the cadence and dates with them first.

booking_reference.description: Booking reference given at confirmation, e.g. "18492".

session.description: The session from speedy_public_enter_code (the person signed in). Leave it out when this connection was signed in to Speedy Sticks. To sign in: ask the person for their email, call speedy_public_sign_in to send them a one-time code, ask them for the code, then call speedy_public_enter_code. Pass the session it returns as `session`.

frequency.description: weekly, biweekly (every other week) or monthly.

end_date.description: Last possible visit date; omit for open-ended.

order_expires.description: Expiration date printed on the provider's standing order, if they have one. Visits stop at whichever of this and end_date comes first.

number_of_people.description: People drawn at each visit, when more than one.

idempotency_key.description: Client-generated unique key (e.g. a UUID). Resending the same key with the same arguments returns the original result instead of repeating the action.

tools.name: speedy_public_get_standing_order
tools.description: Requires sign-in. Returns the standing order a booking belongs to: status (REQUESTED, ACTIVE, PAUSED, ENDED), cadence, price per visit, the rules, and `upcoming` — visits already scheduled, then the planned dates after them. `history` lists every change to it and who made it (the person, an AI assistant, Speedy Sticks), newest first. Works with the reference of the original booking or of any later visit.

session.description: The session from speedy_public_enter_code (the person signed in). Leave it out when this connection was signed in to Speedy Sticks. To sign in: ask the person for their email, call speedy_public_sign_in to send them a one-time code, ask them for the code, then call speedy_public_enter_code. Pass the session it returns as `session`.

booking_reference.description: Booking reference given at confirmation, e.g. "18492".

tools.name: speedy_public_change_standing_order_visit
tools.description: Requires sign-in. Changes ONE upcoming visit and leaves the rest of the standing order as it is: use it for "skip next Tuesday" or "move next month's visit to the 12th". Name the visit by visit_date (from `upcoming` in speedy_public_get_standing_order). action=skip drops it: free with notice; inside the notice window it is charged in full, so the first call returns confirmation_required with the fee and nothing is cancelled until you call again with confirm_late_fee=true after the person agrees. action=move puts it on new_date (optionally a new arrival-window start), between the visit before it and the visit after it; a visit Speedy Sticks already confirmed becomes a request they review. The original booking itself is changed with the ordinary cancel tool, not here.

booking_reference.description: Booking reference given at confirmation, e.g. "18492".

session.description: The session from speedy_public_enter_code (the person signed in). Leave it out when this connection was signed in to Speedy Sticks. To sign in: ask the person for their email, call speedy_public_sign_in to send them a one-time code, ask them for the code, then call speedy_public_enter_code. Pass the session it returns as `session`.

visit_date.description: Date of the visit to change, as listed in upcoming.

new_window_start_time.description: For move: new start of the arrival window (06:00–17:00 local); omit to keep the same time.

reason.description: For move: why, in the person's words.

confirm_late_fee.description: For skip inside the notice window: true only after the person has agreed to the fee returned by the first call.

tools.name: speedy_public_update_standing_order
tools.description: Requires sign-in. Manages the whole standing order behind a booking. pause takes a break until pause_until (within the limit in rules.max_pause_weeks; omitted, it pauses to that limit) and visits resume on their own; resume ends a pause now; change sets how often it repeats (weekly, biweekly, monthly), counted from the most recent visit; cancel ends it for good at no fee. Pausing or ending releases visits that can still be released for free and leaves any that are too close; the result lists both. Cancel is two-phase: confirm=false previews, confirm=true with an idempotency_key executes after the person agrees.

booking_reference.description: Booking reference given at confirmation, e.g. "18492".

session.description: The session from speedy_public_enter_code (the person signed in). Leave it out when this connection was signed in to Speedy Sticks. To sign in: ask the person for their email, call speedy_public_sign_in to send them a one-time code, ask them for the code, then call speedy_public_enter_code. Pass the session it returns as `session`.

pause_until.description: For pause: the date visits start again.

idempotency_key.description: Client-generated unique key (e.g. a UUID). Resending the same key with the same arguments returns the original result instead of repeating the action.

tools.name: speedy_public_suggest_improvement
tools.description: Passes a suggestion on to the Speedy Sticks team, who keep a list of feature requests. Use it when the person suggests an improvement or asks for something Speedy Sticks does not offer yet (offer to pass it on, and send it once they agree), and, with from='assistant', when these tools would not let you do something the person reasonably wanted. Not for complaints about a visit, billing disputes or anything that needs a reply: those go to Speedy Sticks support. One suggestion per call, about the service only: never include names, contact details, dates of birth, booking references or health information. Sending the same suggestion twice does not file it twice.

suggestion.description: What should be different, in one or two plain sentences, e.g. 'Offer Saturday appointments' or 'Let me change the address of a visit that is already confirmed'. About the service only: NO names, email addresses, phone numbers, dates of birth, booking references or health details.

from.description: 'person': the person's own idea or request, passed on with their agreement. 'assistant': something you could not do for them with these tools, reported on your own account.
